entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikhail Pavlovich Malakhov was a Russian architect who graduated from the Imperial Academy of Arts in 1802 and was active primarily in Yekaterinburg. He was responsible for many Neoclassical buildings in the Urals, including private residences and churches.
